about:
SMT Manufacturing Group LLC operates from Hallam, Pennsylvania, and was founded in 2001 by Mark Gingalewski, who serves as managing partner. The company describes itself as a small business focused on contract electronic assembly for commercial and military customers, with a mission to become the primary contract manufacturer of choice.

The facility specializes in fine-pitch surface mount assembly, through-hole assembly, and complete box-build integration, supported by automated optical and X-ray inspection, RoHS-compliant processing, and in-house programming of AVR, PIC, and development boards. The shop is structured for small-batch, quick-turn work, typically handling runs under 1,000 units with a two-week average turnaround.

Customers span commercial and military sectors, with the company highlighting its ability to manage both electrical design and test requirements. The staff includes IPC-certified instructors and adheres to IPC-610/620 Class 3 and J-STD-001 standards, supported by an ISO 9001:2015 quality system.

Gingalewski, a BSEE graduate with over 20 years in military electronics before co-founding the firm, emphasizes direct access to ownership and engineering staff as a differentiator, aiming to provide personalized service that larger contract manufacturers cannot match.
